title: The balanced nested layout
html:
Assume @eq-tw-nested-model for a balanced nested layout with a≥2, b≥2, m≥2. Write μij for the mean of level (i,j) of B and μ¯i⋅=b−1∑jμij.

  1. The four matrices @eq-tw-nested-projections are mutually orthogonal projections summing to I, with ranks 1, a−1, a(b−1) and ab(m−1). The first three sum to the projection onto the mean space. Moreover PB(A)=PB+PAB, where PB and PAB are the projections @eq-tw-five-projections of the crossed layout of the same shape.

  2. The sums of squares are SSA=bm∑i(y¯i⋅⋅−y¯⋅⋅⋅)2,SSB(A)=m∑i∑j(y¯ij⋅−y¯i⋅⋅)2,SSE=∑i,j,k(yijk−y¯ij⋅)2. So SSB(A) is the sum over i of the between-levels sums of squares of B computed separately within each level of A.

  3. The function λ0μ+∑iλiαi+∑i,jκijβj(i) is estimable iff λi=∑jκij for every i and λ0=∑iλi. In particular βj(i)−βl(i) is estimable, but βj(i)−βl(k) with i≠k is not, and αi−αk is not, while αi−αk+β¯⋅(i)−β¯⋅(k)=μ¯i⋅−μ¯k⋅ is.

  4. The expected mean squares are EMSA=σ2+bma−1∑i(μ¯i⋅−μ¯⋅⋅)2,EMSB(A)=σ2+ma(b−1)∑i,j(μij−μ¯i⋅)2,EMSE=σ2. Under normal errors the three sums of squares are independent, and FA=MSA/MSE and FB(A)=MSB(A)/MSE have noncentral F distributions with (a−1,ab(m−1)) and (a(b−1),ab(m−1)) degrees of freedom and noncentralities equal to σ−2 times the sums in the numerators above. So FA is an exact test of μ¯1⋅=⋯=μ¯a⋅, and FB(A) of μij=μ¯i⋅ for all i,j.
